entities.name: Emancipation and Apprenticeship Period
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Emancipation Act of 1834 officially freed enslaved people but imposed a transitional apprenticeship system requiring continued labor until 1838. Full freedom came on August 1, 1838.
